oneLine: Dr Lal PathLabs to acquire 70% stake in SN Genelab for Rs 168 crore.

sources.title: Dr Lal PathLabs to acquire 70 pc stake in SN Genelab for Rs 168 crore

synopsis: Diagnostic services provider Dr Lal PathLabs Ltd has announced that its board of directors approved the acquisition of a 70 per cent stake in Gujarat-based SN Genelab for approximately Rs 168 crore. The transaction includes an additional performance-linked earn-out capped at Rs 31.5 crore. Upon completion of the deal, which is expected by November 30, 2026, SN Genelab will become a subsidiary of Dr Lal PathLabs. The acquisition is intended to strengthen expertise in genomics and broaden the buyer's portfolio of advanced diagnostic services. SN Genelab previously posted a turnover of Rs 57.96 crore in FY26. The transaction does not fall within related-party transactions and requires no governmental or regulatory approvals.
